Hi Tom / Priya,

Thanks again for moving this forward — congrats on getting to the final validation steps. We should schedule a 60-minute rollout planning call to walk through the cutover sequence, owner runbooks, and rollback/fallback policies so your on-call and infra teams are comfortable with the plan.

Proposed agenda:
- 10m: Goals and success criteria (Priya/Tom)
- 25m: Cutover steps and timing (Redwood SE + ACME infra)
- 15m: Rollback/fallback playbook and owners
- 10m: Outstanding dependencies & validation checks

Proposed slots (PST) this week:
- Tue 3/24 10:00-11:00
- Tue 3/24 14:00-15:00
- Wed 3/25 09:00-10:00

Alex (SE) and Dev (SRE) will drive the cutover/rollback sections. I attached the current cutover draft and rollback playbook for reference. Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (networking/infra/security/procurement).

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0132

- rollback-playbook-ACME.docx

- Can the rollback playbook include the exact DB/feature flags to toggle?
